status_meaning.tested: CI tests run it, and it ran on the real thing it reads: real public dataset files, or the real protocol library (pylsl, websockets, BrainFlow) in a loopback.
status_meaning.experimental: Code and CI tests on synthetic data exist. It has not run on real recordings or a real device.

support_meaning.real-device: It ran on a real device (column "Real device"). The evidence is in the repository.
support_meaning.replay-only: It ran on real recorded data (public dataset files, real recording files or real decoder output). It never ran on a live device.
support_meaning.synthetic-only: Its tests use synthetic data only (files made by the test, a fake or synthetic board, a loopback of the real protocol library with synthetic streams).
support_meaning.untested: No test runs it. Planned rows only (no code).

transports.dataset: reads the files of a public dataset
transports.brainflow: BrainFlow board API (live, in the same process)
transports.in-process: a Python call in the same process

kinds.dataset-replay: reads a public dataset and emits NTS streams
kinds.dataset-reader: reads the raw files of a public dataset
kinds.decoder-output: turns the output of any decoder into NTS
kinds.file-reader: reads a recording file format (signal source)

adapters.target: Brain-to-Text '25 (Card et al. 2024, participant T15, attempted speech): phoneme CTC logits
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC0 (Dryad).
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic phoneme logits. Real: the T15 copy-task file of the public dataset, in a local test (skipped in CI without the file).
adapters.limits: Replays recorded decoder output of one participant (T15). No live intracortical source. The published decoder weights have no hash (conformance check PV-WEIGHTS fails).

adapters.target: BrainFlow boards (OpenBCI Cyton, Ganglion and others) -> LSL, and in-process in fidetype live (BrainFlowSource). CI uses the BrainFlow Synthetic board and a fake board only
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. brainflow is MIT. Real boards untested (roadmap P4-06, needs hardware).
adapters.test_covers: CI: the BrainFlow Synthetic board (sine waves and noise, no text) and a fake board; the bridge into a real pylsl loopback.
adapters.limits: No real board is tested (P4-06, externally blocked: needs hardware). Fixed timing only: a board gives no key-onset markers. No reconnect in fidetype live.

adapters.target: Any CTC decoder: (T, V) logits, probabilities or log-probabilities (.npy / .npz, batches)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. No dependency beyond NumPy.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic logits, probabilities and padded batches. Real: the output of our emg2qwerty decoder (P11-01: 2,445 streams, all trust-ready, local run); the pretrained decoders call it on each decode.
adapters.limits: The input must be CTC scores (T, V) with a known vocabulary. It cannot check that the scores come from the decoder that the header names.

adapters.target: EDF, EDF+ (continuous) and BDF files (many EEG, EMG and sleep systems)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0; open format, no third-party code. Data: the licence of each file.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic EDF, EDF+ and BDF files made by the test. Real: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB EDF+ and the MNE test EDF+ / BDF files, in a local test (values equal MNE within one digital step; skipped in CI without the files).
adapters.limits: Continuous files only: EDF+D (discontinuous) raises an error. A file, not a live device.

adapters.target: emg2qwerty (Meta, wrist sEMG during touch typing, 108 users): key presses per prompt
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: research only, streams carry data.research_only = true.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic HDF5 sessions made by the test. Real: the emg2qwerty sessions in P11-01 (decoder training, 2,445 streams) and P6-02 (benchmark baselines), local runs.
adapters.limits: Data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: research use only. Recorded sessions only; the wristband that recorded them is not a supported device.

adapters.target: KT-sEMG (Nokia, forearm sEMG during natural typing): key presses, LDA reference decoder
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY 4.0 (copyright 2021 Nokia).
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic key logs and signal files. The CI job tools/ci/kt_lsl_replay.py downloads the real KT-sEMG run3 (SHA-256 pinned) and trains the reference decoder on it.
adapters.limits: One public dataset. In the CI job the LDA reference decoder is in-sample (a plumbing check, no accuracy claim).

adapters.target: KT-sEMG recording replayed as live raw-signal LSL streams (fidetype live replay-kt)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY 4.0 (copyright 2021 Nokia). pylsl is MIT.
adapters.test_covers: CI: the real KT-sEMG run3 (77 s, 32 channels, 2000 Hz) replayed over a real LSL loopback into fidetype live; the NTS output is checked.
adapters.limits: A replay of a recording, not a live device. The guard never commits on 77 s (in-sample plumbing model).

adapters.target: Lab Streaming Layer: NTS in (LSL inlets -> trust layer) and out (NTS files -> LSL outlets)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. pylsl and liblsl are MIT. No LSL code copied.
adapters.test_covers: CI: fake inlets (header mapping, clock correction, gaps, loss, reconnect) and a real pylsl outlet -> inlet loopback with synthetic streams. Real (P4-21, local): the 816 B2T '25 M4-06 test trials over a real pylsl loopback; hypothesis route decisions equal the in-process replay and the batch harness (816 / 816); 161,503 double64 frames bit-equal.
adapters.limits: One machine only (localhost). The real replay is local (not in CI), unpaced, and does not run the frames-route trust decisions. No live device.

adapters.target: Any raw-signal LSL stream and its marker stream (LSLSource of fidetype live; reconnect P4-11)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. pylsl is MIT.
adapters.test_covers: CI: the synthetic typist over fake inlets and a real pylsl loopback (loss and reconnect). The CI job replays the real KT-sEMG run3 over LSL into fidetype live --source lsl.
adapters.limits: No real amplifier has sent its LSL stream to it (P4-06). Clock correction is tested on one machine only.

adapters.target: OpenBCI GUI v5+ raw recordings (Cyton, Cyton + Daisy, Ganglion)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0; no OpenBCI code used. Data: the licence of each recording.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic GUI files and packet drops (Sample Index jumps). Real: the OpenBCI GUI v6 sample file (Cyton, millisecond time stamps) and two GUI v5 recordings (Cyton 8 ch; Cyton + Daisy 16 ch), local tests.
adapters.limits: No real recording with non-zero markers (P4-19). The Ganglion Sample Index rule is not checked (P4-20). GUI v4 files are refused. A file, not a live board.

adapters.target: SpanishBCBL typing MEG (Brain2Qwerty data): ConvCTC output per typing segment
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY-NC 4.0: research only, streams carry data.research_only = true.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic log-probs (conformance helper and restamp tests). Real: the ConvCTC output on the SpanishBCBL MEG segments of the 5 M1-09 runs (1,074 streams each), rebuilt with this adapter's header by restamp_meg, reach conformance level provenance (M5-13, local).
adapters.limits: Data CC BY-NC 4.0: research only. Recorded MEG only: MEG needs a lab system, so no live MEG source exists.

adapters.target: SpanishBCBL typing MEG: file discovery, behavioural logs, clock alignment, typed text
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY-NC 4.0 (research only). Brain2Qwerty loader (CC BY-NC): not copied.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic file names, logs and clocks. Real: one finished S25 block of the local cache (integration test, skipped in CI).
adapters.limits: Data CC BY-NC 4.0: research only. Needs MNE for the raw MEG files.

adapters.target: Synthetic typist signal with key-press markers (SyntheticSource; no real data)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Synthetic data, no licence needed.
adapters.test_covers: CI: the synthetic typist signal through fidetype live and the adapter conformance helper.
adapters.limits: Synthetic signal only. It carries no brain or muscle data. Use it to test the plumbing.

adapters.target: Any text-only decoder: CSV id,text or JSON Lines n-best lists -> hypothesis stream
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. No dependency beyond the standard library and NumPy.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic CSV and JSON Lines n-best files. Real: the item check (normalise_item) on the KT-sEMG LDA n-best lists through the trust drop-in (P5-33, local); read_csv and read_jsonl on real B2T '25 decoder output (1,718 online 1-best texts, 816 M4-06 10-best lists with evidence): exact round trip, 0 conformance failures (P4-22, local).
adapters.limits: The real CSV / JSON Lines files come from our converter (no local tool writes these forms); the real texts have no CSV quoting cases. One dataset family.

adapters.target: Toronto sEMG typing dataset (Achituve et al. 2025, forearm sEMG, 19 participants): key presses
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0 (own Intan RHD reader). Data CC BY 4.0. Baseline code CC BY-SA 4.0: not copied.
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic Intan RHD files made by a test writer. Real: the Toronto CleanData files, in a local test (skipped in CI without the data).
adapters.limits: Recorded sessions only; no live Intan source.

adapters.target: Willett et al. 2021 handwriting BCI: real-time RNN character output
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC0. Reads sentences.mat with SciPy (BSD-3-Clause).
adapters.test_covers: CI: synthetic sessions. Real: sentences.mat of the public archive (SHA-256 pinned) in the P6-02 benchmark baselines (local).
adapters.limits: Replays recorded real-time RNN output of one participant (T5). The RNN weights have no hash (PV-WEIGHTS fails).

adapters.target: WebSocket binding nts-ws/0.1 (FEP-0004): NTS in both directions, decisions out
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. websockets is BSD-3-Clause.
adapters.test_covers: CI: sans-IO cores (order, gaps, resume, auth) and a real server and client on localhost with synthetic streams. Real: the 816 Brain-to-Text '25 test trials over WebSocket, same decisions as the in-process replay (M6-11, local).
adapters.limits: Localhost only; no test across a real network.
